content.title: 250 Housing Units with Commercial Rental and Concierge Services
summary: A 250-home rent-to-own residential development in Bouraada, Reghaia, featuring commercial premises, concierge spaces, and secondary works.
The Reghaia development comprises seven R+9 blocks, designed to provide practical family housing, local services, and concierge spaces that enhance residents' daily lives.
description: The project provides 250 rent-to-own homes, with four units per floor and a clear mix of F3 and F4 units, complemented by commercial premises and concierge spaces.
Igloo completed the remaining secondary works, facade construction, technical installations, and external landscaping, bringing the seven-block site to a habitable residential standard.
content.authority: A seven-block rent-to-own development completed through the essential work that makes housing habitable: facades, finishes, utility networks, and daily service spaces.
